title: Prince and Princess of Wales join Royal Ascot racegoers
originalTitle: Prince and Princess of Wales join Royal Ascot racegoers
content:
Prince and princess join Royal Ascot racegoers

Thousands of people enjoyed the second day of Royal Ascot.

One of the of the highlights of the summer social calendar, it is taking place over five days at the Berkshire's Ascot Racecourse.
